skill_name: Explain how social media can be used to inform better business decisions.
workflow: Social media can be used to inform better business decisions by providing businesses with valuable data about customers and their interests. With this data, businesses can gain valuable insights into customer needs, preferences, and behaviors. Social media can help businesses track trends and monitor customer sentiment, allowing them to quickly adjust their decisions and strategies to meet changing market needs. Additionally, social media provides a platform for businesses to build relationships
